peer_results.rationale: The provided candidates for INTC (intc_2024_8_D179 on Operating Lease Expense and intc_2024_8_D129 on Licensed Technology Amortization) do not address tangible property depreciation expense or general accumulated amortization of leasehold improvements which constitutes the core of the target disclosure. While both involve 'amortization', INTC's candidate focuses on leased facilities and specific technology licenses rather than the broad depreciation of owned tangible assets and finance lease improvements reported by NVDA.

The provided candidates for MU (mu_2024_8_D044 on Future Intangible Asset Amortization and mu_2024_8_D043 on Intangible Asset Capitalization/Amortization) focus on intangible assets like product and process technology. The target disclosure concerns depreciation of tangible assets and amortization of leasehold improvements/finance leases. These are distinct accounting categories (intangible vs. tangible/lease) and thus not substantively comparable.
